{{Quote|This is Sentry Post A9 reporting. Something just crash-landed about a kilometer northeast of the base. Looked like an escape pod, but I could't be sure. You'd better send a scout to check it out. There could be survivors.|A Rebel sentry|<ref name="Introductory Adventure Game">''[[Introductory Adventure Game]]''</ref>}}
'''Sentry Post A9''' was an [[Sentry tower/Legends|observation tower]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Edan Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. The sentry monitored a potential crashlanding [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and recommended a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] be dispatched to check it out.
